description: This Democrat is trying to knock out years-long GOP Congressman Dan Crenshaw in a deep-red Republican district. Business executive Shaun Finnie, a Woodlands resident, announced his candidacy in July, saying his decision to run was driven largely by concern over the nation’s growing federal debt. Finnie reiterated this focus in a newly released campaign video […]
